title: SDXL
description: Text to image with Stable Diffusion XL: 25 steps, with a negative prompt.

labels.10:text: Describe the image: subject, setting, light and style.
labels.11:text: Negative prompt (what to keep out of the image)
labels.12:cfg: CFG (how closely to follow the prompt)

hints: Short, comma-separated phrases work well: the subject first, then setting, light and style.
The negative prompt lists what to keep out. Its starting value keeps colour out: clear it if you want a colour image.
SDXL is trained around 1024 px. Much larger sizes can repeat the subject.
25 steps and CFG 7 are a good default. More steps are slower with little gain.
